title: polypodium aureum f. mazei
intro: Polypodium aureum f. mazei, commonly known as Goldenseal, is a plant species belonging to the Polypodiaceae family and is a type of fern. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Goldenseal include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, making it effective in treating conditions such as skin infections, wounds, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Goldenseal include berberine, which is responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties.
